pages.text: The debugging tool looks like a fly swatter. Right-click any c0de block with it to see all its properties. For a red line number, it tells you what is wrong.
Hit a debug trigger block with it to start a process with a red $(l)debug cursor$(). The debug cursor starts paused.

$(li)Left-click the paused cursor: it moves one line.$(li)Shift-left-click the cursor: it runs on its own, or pauses again.$(li)Right-click any cursor: see its properties and its stack.$(li)Shift-right-click a PID block: abort the process.
Recipe: a red wool block bottom left, a stick in the middle and a leather top right.
